final_claim: For all 256 elementary rules r in reversible second-order binary CA R(u,v)=(v,u xor F_r(v)), third-iterate fixed-state spatial growth h_r splits into 129 positive-entropy, 116 bounded nonempty, 11 identically empty cases; rules 51,204 have h=log4, and among all others only 50,76 have maximal h=log(lambda) with lambda positive >1 root of t^4-2t^3-2t^2-6t+3, whereas remaining 252 have h<log(25/8). The exact period3 count for r50,76 is S_n+6 1_{3|n}.
